tweets: Price oracle manipulation exploits vulnerabilities in price feeds to alter contract logic.
This can lead to unauthorized actions, loss of funds, or exploitation of the contract's core logic.
Remediation requires using decentralized oracles for price data.
Ensure all oracle data is properly validated before use.
Aggregate multiple sources like median or mean of several DEXs and oracles.
